name: RF / antenna keep-out clearance
description: Advisory (needs a designated antenna/RF keep-out region): copper inside an antenna keep-out detunes the antenna and kills range. Flags copper found inside any 'antenna'/'rf' keep-out region supplied via design data (sidecar keepouts). Not_applicable when no such region is designated.
what_it_measures: Count of copper features found inside a designated antenna/RF keep-out region.
